Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and
technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public
cloud, data science, Al, engineering innovation and loT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and
silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration,
with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in
person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Visual Designers for Brand and Design Systems, to join our mission to turn complex, open-source
software into efficient, intuitive products that can change how complex systems are built and conceptions of what
open source is capable of. We are looking for exceptional designers, who share our passion for impacting the lives of
